title: Bug reproduced: unpatched autodetector emits AlterField with empty _auto_deps for UUIDField→FK change (repro exits FAIL)

Bug reproduced: unpatched autodetector emits AlterField with empty _auto_deps for UUIDField→FK change (repro FAILs); with the fix it emits ('repro_app2','App2',None,True) and migration dep ('repro_app2','__first__') (repro PASSes)

UUID→FK bug reproduced: unpatched autodetector gives AlterField _auto_deps=[] (repro FAIL); with fix, _auto_deps=[('repro_app2','App2',None,True)] and migration dep ('repro_app2','__first__') (repro PASS)

UUID→FK bug reproduced: unpatched autodetector gives AlterField _auto_deps=[] (repro FAIL); with fix, _auto_deps=[('repro_app2','App2',None,True)] and migration dep ('repro_app2','__first__') (repro PASS)
With the fix, Django's migrations test module passes: 514 tests OK (runtests.py migrations --parallel=1), incl. all 112 autodetector tests
